translations.web: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
translations.bsb: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.
translations.kjv: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
translations.asv: and the enemy that sowed them is the devil: and the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are angels.
